change: History/service boundary detection uses full acquisition-row timestamp gaps above1second only; participant boundaries always reset. A retained-row interval above1second alone does not reset, because a nominal1Hz interval may include harmless acquisition-clock jitter.
reason: Root independent adapter review identified that the redundant retained-row gap rule could split otherwise continuous physical chains at ordinary sampling jitter.
aggregate_budget_scope: A separate loss budgetB applies to each actual participant/history-run chain. Aggregate lower-return protection is−B times actual run count, not a fixed ten-test-participant multiplier when timestamp gaps create additional runs.
